title: Declining an Estimate and Releasing a Stored Vehicle — Repair Estimates & Appointments
content:
### Declining

Declining is the customer's own decision: the desk records a decline request on the Repair Estimates & Appointments booking and the booking moves to declined only once the customer confirms it. The condition is that the customer's decline request on the booking is confirmed, as the booking's request record shows (a decline request in confirmed status); a decline request still pending the customer's confirmation does not move the booking.

### Releasing a vehicle left at the center

A vehicle left at the center for a teardown estimate (an estimate type on which storage can accrue) is released only when nothing is outstanding on the booking. The condition is that the booking's estimate-stage charges are fully paid or waived. What is outstanding on a charge is its amount less every payment and every waiver that names that charge; what is outstanding on the booking is that figure summed over every estimate-stage charge of the booking.

Release records the vehicle released date and ends storage accrual on that date.

### Lien process

When accrued storage reaches the estimate type's lien referral days without release, the vehicle enters the abandoned-vehicle lien process, which the desk does not handle.

### Charges after a decline

Teardown, scan and measurement charges posted at the estimate stay due after a decline; no credit applies to a declined booking.

### Release check (hypothetical booking)

| Charge on the booking | Amount | Paid | Waived | Outstanding |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Teardown | 200.00 USD | 150.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 50.00 USD |
| Pre-repair scan | 50.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 50.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Booking total | | | | 50.00 USD |

With 50.00 USD outstanding the vehicle is not released; once the teardown's remaining 50.00 USD is paid or waived, nothing is outstanding and release may be recorded.
